create_rl_environment: create an Open Spiel RL environment for a specified game with configurable discount and observation type
reset_game_environment: reset the Open Spiel environment to start a new game sequence and return the initial timestep
step_game_environment: step the Open Spiel environment with actions and return the resulting timestep with observations and rewards
sample_chance_events: sample external chance events from a game state using a seeded random number generator
get_observation_action_specs: get observation and action specifications for an Open Spiel RL environment
